historical_pattern.summary: MST-wi: an X-Forwarded-User (or similar) header must not grant a privileged body the baseline request did not have.

entrypoints: HTTP object GET with spoofed forwarded-user header

invariant: Adding X-Forwarded-User must not introduce a secret absent from the baseline response.

oracle.success_means: the forwarded-user header granted a secret the baseline response did not contain

severity_rationale: Spoofed forwarding headers are a common authentication-bypass class when a proxy is assumed.
